covers: Friday 13 November 2026: JSE close and the US session to about 20:25 SAST
headline: Chip selloff deepens (AMD -10.5%, Cisco -6.2%) as HSBC downgrades Nvidia; Nasdaq -1.2%, 10-year yield 5.14%
summary: The JSE All Share closed at 112,387.86 (-0.4%) and the Top 40 at 104,486.62 (-0.5%), with SPAR down 4.4% and Standard Bank 2.1% lower after a reported R17 million fine (LRC Market Dashboard and LRC Stock Scanner (Yahoo Finance), 13 Nov 2026; Daily Investor headline). In New York the Nasdaq was 1.2% lower and the S&P 500 0.7% lower at about 20:25 SAST, but both remain about 2% up on the week; AMD fell 10.5%, Broadcom 5.2% and Nvidia 3.1% as CNBC reported an HSBC downgrade of Nvidia, with the US 10-year yield at 5.14% (LRC Market Dashboard and LRC Stock Scanner (Yahoo Finance), 12-13 Nov 2026; CNBC headline, 13 Nov 2026 18:24 SAST). The rand closed at R16.91/$, 2.6% weaker on the week, gold at $3,887.80 (-4.6% on the week) and Brent at $96.01 (LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance), 6-13 Nov 2026).

items.title: HSBC downgrades Nvidia, saying the stock will struggle until a new CEO is named
items.summary: CNBC reported the downgrade at 18:24 SAST, following Jensen Huang's departure as chief executive reported earlier on Friday. Nvidia was at $161.06 (-3.1%) at 20:25 SAST; MarketWatch reports it has shed $657 billion of market value this week. We could not open the article, so the new rating and price target are not given here.
items.source: CNBC headline, 13 Nov 2026 18:24 SAST; MarketWatch headline, 13 Nov 2026; LRC Stock Scanner quotes (Yahoo Finance NVDA), 13 Nov 2026 20:25 SAST

items.title: Chip selloff deepens: AMD -10.5%, Cisco -6.2%, Broadcom -5.2%, Applied Materials -4.8%
items.summary: At 20:25 SAST AMD was at $523.79, Cisco at $95.64, Broadcom at $345.36 and Applied Materials at $362.81. CNBC also reports Treasury Secretary Bessent criticising Nvidia chip 'leakage' to China.
items.source: LRC Stock Scanner quotes (Yahoo Finance AMD, CSCO, AVGO, AMAT), 13 Nov 2026 20:25 SAST; CNBC headlines, 13 Nov 2026 19:06 and 19:48 SAST

items.title: Nasdaq down 1.2%, S&P 500 down 0.7% on Friday, both still about 2% up on the week
items.summary: At 20:25 SAST the S&P 500 was at 7,539.58 and the Nasdaq Composite at 25,062.98, against Thursday closes of 7,592.40 and 25,366.09 and 6 November closes of 7,376.86 and 24,579.43. CNBC's live blog says major averages are up for the week.
items.source: LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance ^GSPC, ^IXIC), 6, 12 and 13 Nov 2026; CNBC headline, 13 Nov 2026 19:36 SAST

items.title: US 10-year Treasury yield at 5.14% after the producer price report
items.summary: The 10-year yield was 5.141% at 20:25 SAST, up from 5.103% on Thursday and 4.859% a week ago; CNBC's headline put it at 5.17% earlier in the session.
items.source: LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance ^TNX), 6, 12 and 13 Nov 2026; CNBC headline, 13 Nov 2026 19:39 SAST

items.title: US home sales at the lowest level since the Great Recession as prices hit a record
items.summary: MarketWatch reports home sales falling to their lowest level since the 'Great Recession' while prices reach an all-time high.

items.title: Microsoft 0.2% higher as it apologises for the Outlook and 365 outage
items.summary: Microsoft was at $524.14 at 20:25 SAST. CNBC reports the company apologised for the outage that took down Outlook and other 365 services.
items.source: LRC Stock Scanner quotes (Yahoo Finance MSFT), 13 Nov 2026 20:25 SAST; CNBC headline, 13 Nov 2026 20:18 SAST

items.title: Dollar heads for its biggest weekly gain since September
items.summary: Investing.com reports the dollar on course for its biggest weekly gain since September as inflation lifts Fed rate-hike expectations.

items.title: JSE ends the week lower: All Share -0.4% on the day at 112,387.86, Top 40 -0.5% at 104,486.62
items.summary: Against Thursday's closes of 112,894.87 and 104,981.31, the All Share finished 0.4% lower and the Top 40 0.5% lower; on the week the All Share is down 0.3% and the Top 40 0.2%. Naspers ended 1.4% lower at R725.37 and Prosus 0.2% lower at R670.40; gold miners were mixed (Gold Fields +0.1%, AngloGold Ashanti -0.1%, Harmony -0.2%). Vodacom gained 1.1% to R179.93.
items.source: LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance ^J203.JO, ^J200.JO), 6, 12 and 13 Nov 2026; LRC Stock Scanner quotes (Yahoo Finance NPN.JO, PRX.JO, GFI.JO, ANG.JO, HAR.JO, VOD.JO), 13 Nov 2026 17:00 SAST

items.title: Standard Bank 2.1% lower; Daily Investor reports a R17 million fine and administrative sanctions
items.summary: Standard Bank was at R305.20 at 17:07 SAST, down 2.1%. Daily Investor reports the bank has been hit with a R17 million fine and administrative sanctions; the regulator's statement had not been verified at the time of writing.
items.source: LRC Stock Scanner quotes (Yahoo Finance SBK.JO), 13 Nov 2026 17:07 SAST; Daily Investor headline, 13 Nov 2026 17:12 SAST

items.title: Nvidia: $161.06 (-3.1%); HSBC downgrade after the CEO's exit
items.summary: The LRC Stock Scanner rates Nvidia HOLD; the price is well below the $210.96 used in the LRC Watchlist investment list (23 Oct 2026). CNBC reports HSBC downgraded the stock after Jensen Huang's departure. The LRC rating is unchanged here and is reassessed by the scanner on its next run. Results are expected on 17 November.
items.source: LRC Stock Scanner quotes (Yahoo Finance NVDA), 13 Nov 2026 20:25 SAST; CNBC headline, 13 Nov 2026 18:24 SAST; LRC Watchlist, 7 Nov 2026
